finding.detail: After a reverse has installed an owned departure transform, a direction change without group capture makes restart return false and starts the new off-center phase with restarted=false, resetting the not-before deadline to zero. A previously queued transform transitionend is then accepted immediately for that phase and may detach the live view prematurely. The direction test waits for fallback and the stale-event test covers only a successful restart. Add failed/no-capture and consumer-style/failed-layout restart tests that send an old end immediately, then complete the current phase. Distinguish a defensible early-event filter from exact event-cycle correlation: the deadline cannot prove which native cycle delivered a sufficiently late event.
finding.status: reported to root and author; fix and verification pending

evidence_integrity.archive_members: Inspected metadata without extraction; no links, absolute paths or parent traversal. All 96 manifest-listed files match recorded sizes and hashes.
evidence_integrity.scope_limits: Prior artifact build bases differ from current HEAD and are honestly identified. Jasmine reports 12/12 on each peer; instrumented native lifecycle 8/8 and early reselection 6/6 are bounded Chromium diagnostics, not full coverage. lifecycle_disposition: Archive accurately records the constrained choice and historical difference: reference destroys old Beta before Gamma and leaves its node connected even after reselection; candidate retains and reuses the live view on early reselection, then removes it on later departure. Resources remain active longer and no strict wall-clock completion bound exists. No waiver or historical exactness is inferred.
other_observations: Prior fixes for owned-transform cleanup, reentrant layout and direction-retargeting are present at reviewed hashes. Native 16ms deadline is not an event identity. Inline transform and transition-property checks preserve distinguishable consumer-owned values; full runtime CSS and focus behavior remains bounded by executed samples.
